reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Automatic reminders for unpaid invoices, agreements waiting for a signature and maintenance plans.

how.title: How reminders work
how.daily: Reminders run once a day through the scheduled job at /api/cron/reminders.
how.once: The same reminder is never sent twice for the same item.
how.portal: Clients only receive reminders when their portal is enabled for the project.
how.email: Reminders also go out by email when an email provider is configured. Otherwise they appear in notifications only.
how.whatsapp: A rule can also send its client reminder to the client's phone number by WhatsApp. A client without a valid number is skipped.
